quality_review.observation: Actual3840x2160 PNG viewed: exactly one wider main sheet and four separate copies in2x2; every sheet has upper text area and lower promise area, main shows4 separate pale fingerpress designs, each copy1, and all5 retain the lower-right blank red square seal. Paper borders are complete, no pseudo-writing or added all-household clause. SVG group inspection confirms independent fingerpress/seal groups and shared copy template.
quality_review.decision: Accept as editable prop-layout reference. Marks describe placement/design; turn their SVG groups off for pre-signing/pre-stamping frames. Exact readable clauses remain with the designated text layers; no real biometric identity is represented.
